title: Makee Sensee
description: This texture pack adds a bunch of texture updates that just make sense
body:
Makee Sensee is a vanilla-friendly resource pack that fixes textures to better match how items are actually crafted and used in Minecraft.

Instead of redesigning everything, this pack focuses on small, smart changes that make the game feel more consistent and intuitive. Materials look like what they’re made from, and crafted items visually reflect their ingredients and purpose.

Examples of changes include:

* Paper has a slight green tint, since it’s made from sugarcane
* Target blocks clearly resemble compressed hay
* Fletching tables feature a proper target design to match their use with arrows
* (More consistency fixes across tools, blocks, and items)

The goal is simple: make players think “that just makes sense.”

Perfect for players who want a more logical, immersive experience while staying true to the vanilla style.
